key.name: has-token
key.description: Whether the user has saved a GitHub token in GNOME Keyring. The token value itself is never stored in GSettings.

key.name: active-poll-interval
key.description: Polling interval in seconds when at least one monitored workflow run is active.

key.name: idle-poll-interval
key.description: Polling interval in seconds when no monitored workflow run is active.

key.name: history-days
key.description: Number of days to keep workflow run history locally.

key.name: notify-failures
key.description: Whether to notify failed, cancelled, timed-out, and action-required workflow runs.

key.name: notify-watched-success
key.description: Whether to notify successful completion for runs explicitly marked as watched.

key.name: notify-all-completions
key.description: Whether to notify every completed workflow run in selected repositories.
